prerequisites.en: Engineering Mechanics (official prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI03006051)

name.en: Physical and Index Properties of Soil
name.gu: Soil ના Physical અને Index Properties

name.en: Bearing Capacity of Soil and Earth Pressure
name.gu: Soil ની Bearing Capacity અને Earth Pressure

text.en: Identify types of soil according to mode of deposition and mode of transportation.
text.gu: Deposition અને transportation ની રીતે soil ના પ્રકારો ઓળખો.

text.en: Determine the physical and index properties of soil to estimate behaviour and engineering properties for construction activities.
text.gu: Construction માટે soil ના physical અને index properties શોધી behaviour નો અંદાજ કાઢો.

text.en: Classify coarse grained and fine grained soil by IS method.
text.gu: IS method થી coarse અને fine grained soil નું classification કરો.

text.en: Determine coefficient of permeability and shear parameters of soil and apply results in foundation analysis.
text.gu: Permeability નો coefficient અને shear parameters શોધી foundation analysis માં વાપરો.

text.en: Determine O.M.C. and M.D.D. values of soil and select suitable method of soil stabilization.
text.gu: Soil ના O.M.C. અને M.D.D. શોધો અને stabilization ની યોગ્ય પદ્ધતિ પસંદ કરો.

text.en: Compute bearing capacity of soil and earth pressure and interpret results.
text.gu: Soil ની bearing capacity અને earth pressure ગણો અને પરિણામો સમજાવો.
